maddeler.e:
ننسجم (form VII)
# نَنْسَجِمُ (nansajimu) /nan.sa.d͡ʒi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَجَمَ (insajama)
# نَنْسَجِمَ (nansajima) /nan.sa.d͡ʒi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَجَمَ (insajama)
# نَنْسَجِمْ (nansajim) /nan.sa.d͡ʒim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْسَجَمَ (insajama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
